 UN: More Than 1,600 Suspected Dengue Cases Recorded in Afghanistan
 8AM Media 
 19 November 2026 - Solar Hijri Date: 1405/08/28 [t_time:1795105460] 
 VOV.VN
 The World Health Organization (WHO) has reported that 1,675 suspected dengue fever cases were recorded in Afghanistan in October, with one person dying from the disease.
 The organization said on Thursday, November 19, that the number of suspected dengue cases in Afghanistan had increased compared with September.
 According to the report, 364 suspected cases were recorded in September, with no deaths reported.
 WHO added that the rise in suspected dengue cases is consistent with the disease’s usual seasonal pattern.
 The organization said the death recorded in October was the first dengue-related death in Afghanistan since January 2026.
